title: Decode Ways
description: Count the number of ways to decode a numeric string to letters.

data.text: A message containing letters from `A-Z` is encoded as numbers (`'A' -> "1", 'B' -> "2", ...`). Given a string of digits `s`, return the total number of ways to decode it.

data.title: Top-down DP O(n)
Bottom-up O(n) O(1)
What improved?
data.text: Bottom-up DP with two variables replaces the memo array and recursion stack. Each position only depends on the previous one or two states.
